data.narrative:
AMP Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Matanya Horowitz that has raised $439.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 9 comparable companies across robotics and manufacturing—1 public and 8 private—including Series A, Series B, and Seed-stage operators such as Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, anchoring to the $30M proxy derived from total raised, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding an implied valuation of $60M. Peer-median analysis across the five most comparable same-sector operators at same or adjacent stage produces a $1.6B median valuation, with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in funding stage and company maturity within the peer cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $51M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $855M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects tension between recent funding activity and peer valuations at more advanced rounds. Key uncertainties include the applicability of higher-stage peer comparables to a Series A company and whether the $439.1M raised represents pre-money or post-money valuation context.
